name: AB-CHMINACA
summary: A synthetic cannabinoid related to AB-FUBINACA. There have been reports of death in overdose, similar to AB-FUBINACA and it has a low threshold dose. Exercise caution.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: It is a potent agonist of the CB1 receptor (Ki = 0.78 nM) and CB2 receptor (Ki = 0.45 nM) and fully substitutes for Δ9-THC in rat discrimination studies, while being 16x more potent.

uses.en: It has been sold as an ingredient in synthetic cannabis products. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它曾作為合成大麻製品的成分販售，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它曾作为合成大麻制品的成分贩售，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Reported effects include a racing heart, vomiting, agitation, anxiety, paranoia, confusion, seizures and loss of consciousness. Deaths have been linked to it, and regular use can lead to dependence and harsh withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 已知的反應包括心跳急促、嘔吐、躁動、焦慮、多疑、意識混亂、癲癇發作與失去意識。它曾與死亡事件有關，長期使用也可能導致成癮與嚴重的戒斷反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 已知的反应包括心跳急促、呕吐、躁动、焦虑、多疑、意识混乱、癫痫发作与失去意识。它曾与死亡事件有关，长期使用也可能导致成瘾与严重的戒断反应。

fact.en: In rat tests it fully stood in for THC while being many times more potent, which is typical of these indazole carboxamides and part of why they are so risky.
fact.zh: 在大鼠測試中，它能完全替代THC，效力卻高出好幾倍；這是這類吲唑甲醯胺的典型特性，也是它們之所以危險的原因之一。
fact.zhHans: 在大鼠测试中，它能完全替代THC，效力却高出好几倍；这是这类吲唑甲酰胺的典型特性，也是它们之所以危险的原因之一。
